= incomplete-link-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: rouge
:close: ]
:open: [
:target: https://attribute.example

== Name
incomplete-link-subs - respect enabled link substitutions

== Synopsis

[source,text,subs="+macros,+quotes"]
----
S01 link:https://unfinished.example[Unfinished *bold* and https://valid.example.
S02 link:https://unfinished.example[Unfinished https://inner.example[Inner]
S03 link:user@example.org
S04 link:https://complete.example[Complete]
----

[source,text]
----
S05 link:https://unfinished.example[Unfinished
----

[subs="none"]
S06 link:https://unfinished.example[Unfinished *bold* and https://other.example.

[subs="macros,attributes"]
S07 link:https://unfinished.example[Late{close}

[subs="attributes,macros"]
S08 link:https://complete.example[Early{close}

[subs="macros,attributes"]
S09 link:https://unfinished.example{open}Late]

[subs="attributes,macros"]
S10 link:https://complete.example{open}Early]

S11 link:{target}[Complete]

S12 link:{target}[Unfinished

S13 pass:m[link:https://unfinished.example[Unfinished]

S14 pass:m[link:https://complete.example[Complete\]]

S15 pass:m,a[link:https://unfinished.example[Late{close}]

S16 pass:a,m[link:https://complete.example[Early{close}]
